turns.question: It's the end of 5 October 2026 and our fiscal year starts on 1 February. What has our average daily revenue been so far this fiscal quarter, counting days with no orders as zero and leaving cancelled orders out?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no average-daily-revenue metric, and I may not divide figures myself; the closest is revenue_eur (Revenue, non-cancelled orders), which totals 19,573.59 EUR for the fiscal quarter so far, 2026-08-01 to 2026-10-05 (fiscal year starting 1 February). Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
